screens.content: Agenda: 15:00 invoice review at Riverbend Library. Notice: bring PO-2048 and $48.00 to the receiving desk before pickup today, please. Avery copies the address as 48 Market Lane and the vendor code as HN-2048. Lee Ortiz files the signed notice beside the invoice so Maya can collect both. Riverbend Books on the River Road packet uses RB-2076, not HN-2048. Avery keeps a desk copy of the price line in the Friday sleeve. Payment due Friday is a separate field from the dollar total.
